First listed: 2026-07-13 | Evaluation cutoff: 2026-11-10

[Back to library](../README.md)

## Source versions

- [YouTube: AI Dominates Economy and Markets with Torsten Slok | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 68](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xrduTt2651c) - 2026-07-13
- [Substack: AI Dominates Economy and Markets with Torsten Slok](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/ai-dominates-economy-and-markets) - 2026-07-13

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

Slok attributes US resilience to AI spending, reshoring and tax refunds, while warning that higher rates and software refinancing challenge parts of private credit. Eisman questions AI moats and concentration. The interview separates aggregate consumer strength from lower-income stress, compares US and European dynamism, and explores Treasury-demand changes. Both end by warning that conventional portfolios contain more common AI exposure than investors may realize.

Full transcript reviewed. Empirical claims without inspected primary outcome evidence remain unresolved; guest claims are separate from Eisman attribution. Primary outcome verification is incomplete for claims marked unresolved; these are not adverse accuracy grades.

Steve Eisman is the host; Torsten Slok gives the macroeconomic answers. Closing remarks from 3198 onward are Eisman and explicitly adopt selected guest conclusions. Host questions and acknowledgments alone are not treated as endorsement.
